Landing.title: Understand every euro spent across your stack.
Landing.subtitle: Spend connects projects, providers, usage, and invoices to make costs explainable and surface optimizations you can actually defend.
Landing.scope: Financial costs and usage only — no uptime or APM dashboard.
Landing.detectText: Detect services in repositories and retain technical evidence without ever storing code or secret values.
Landing.reconcileText: Reconcile provider APIs, accrued costs, and final invoices without double counting and in their original currency.
Landing.optimizeText: Compare usage against versioned plans with estimated savings, safety margin, freshness, and confidence.
Landing.betaText: We are preparing an invitation-only B2B beta with personal onboarding support.

FeaturesPage.title: A spend hub, not another monitoring tool.
FeaturesPage.subtitle: Technical data is collected only when it explains a cost, quota, or recommendation.
FeaturesPage.inventoryText: GitHub connects detected dependencies to projects, clients, and the accounts that are actually paid.
FeaturesPage.costsText: Commitments, accruals, estimates, and final invoices remain separate and reconcilable.
FeaturesPage.usageText: Billable metrics are compared with verified provider limits and pricing when a verified connector supplies them.
FeaturesPage.invoicesText: The current beta supports reviewed manual invoice totals. Gmail and document imports will only be advertised after their verified connectors ship.
FeaturesPage.recommendationsText: Every saving shows its period, input data, risks, and confidence.
FeaturesPage.allocationsText: Shared spend is allocated after canonical cost creation, never by overwriting the source.
FeaturesPage.boundary: Spend never cancels, changes, or deletes a resource at an external provider.

PricingPage.title: Every core analysis in every plan.
PricingPage.subtitle: Recommendation safety and quality are never reduced to differentiate plans.
PricingPage.trial: 14-day trial with payment method required. Immediate prorated upgrades; downgrades and cancellation take effect at renewal.

SecurityPage.title: Your spend data deserves minimal access and auditable evidence.
SecurityPage.subtitle: Spend limits collection, encrypts credentials, and separates every workspace.
SecurityPage.leastPrivilegeText: Every connector declares read-only capabilities and permissions. Destructive external actions are out of scope.
SecurityPage.credentialsText: Tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, versioned for rotation, and never returned to the browser.
SecurityPage.contentText: No source code, AI prompt, email body, or raw document is retained in logs. Temporary files are purged.
SecurityPage.tenancyText: The authenticated organization determines the server-side workspace; every business table carries that boundary directly.
SecurityPage.recoveryText: Migrations are separate from deployment. Backup and recovery procedures must be rehearsed before commercial launch.
SecurityPage.controlText: Recommendations remain advisory. Users confirm reconciliation and retain the final decision.

LegalDocuments.legalIntro: Intended publisher: Yoann Andrieux, sole trader under the YoDev trading name. Legal and hosting details will be published after validation and before any payment is collected.
LegalDocuments.privacyIntro: Spend processes account, billing, and minimal technical data required to provide the service. Planned retention periods and rights are documented in the compliance plan.
LegalDocuments.termsIntro: The service is available to businesses only. Prices, trial, quotas, cancellation, export, and deletion follow the commercial agreement presented before Checkout.
LegalDocuments.dpaIntro: Spend acts as a processor for customer-imported data and documents purposes, security controls, retention, and onward subprocessors.
LegalDocuments.subprocessorsIntro: The production list will cover hosting, database, authentication, payment, and transactional email, including purpose and location.
LegalDocuments.statusText: This document is product structure, not legal advice. Its contractual version must be approved by Yodev's legal adviser and accountant before production payments are enabled.
LegalDocuments.contactText: YoDev will publish the dedicated contact address for contractual requests and data protection rights before the paid beta.
LegalDocuments.identityPending: The publisher’s complete legal identity must be supplied before commercial launch.
LegalDocuments.contactPending: The professional support address must be confirmed before commercial launch.

PrivacySettings.title: Data and privacy
PrivacySettings.subtitle: Stay in control of your workspace data.
PrivacySettings.exportHelp: The export includes business data and exact amounts, without secret credentials.
PrivacySettings.policy: Connections are disabled as soon as you request deletion. Your workspace remains read-only and exportable for 30 days. Business data is then erased. YoDev seller records subject to legal retention are kept separately.
PrivacySettings.billingHelp: Deletion does not replace cancellation of your subscription.
PrivacySettings.reconnect: Cancelling keeps the data; connections must be restored manually.
PrivacySettings.failed: Operations must retry this job. Remaining data is preserved until then.
PrivacySettings.processing: The cancellation window has ended. Maintenance will process the request.
PrivacySettings.confirmHelp: To confirm, enter the exact workspace name: {name}.
PrivacySettings.exportExpired: The export period has ended. Deletion is being processed.
